title: Vegetable Daliya
description: Broken wheat cooked with mixed vegetables into a light, savoury porridge — a wholesome, easy-to-digest breakfast.
steps: Dry roast the broken wheat in a pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until lightly fragrant, then set aside.
In a pressure cooker, heat oil and add mustard and cumin seeds. Once they sizzle, add the onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the carrot, peas and tomato, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the roasted daliya, turmeric and salt, and stir to combine.
Add the water, close the lid, and pressure cook for 3-4 whistles until the daliya and vegetables are soft.
Let the pressure release naturally, then give it a gentle stir — it will thicken slightly as it cools. Garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
